# Lock control (`lock-control`)

Lock, unlock and unlatch with an inline confirm step and a jammed alert.

Group: Home controls. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/home';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createLockControl` (types in `dist/web/home/lockControl.d.ts`): `.mh-lock-control`: a `__status` line (`__icon`, `__state`, announced politely) and `__actions` with `__button--lock | --unlock | --open`; the button for the current state is disabled. With `confirm`, unlock and open take a second tap: the button reads "Tap again to unlock" (`.is-confirming`) until it is tapped, another button is used, Escape is pressed or the time runs out; no modal. Modifiers `--<state>` (`--jammed` takes the alert tone, `--unknown` when null); states `.is-busy`, `.is-confirming`, `.is-disabled`.

```ts
export function createLockControl(options: LockControlOptions): LockControlHandle;

export interface LockControlOptions {
  /** Accessible name of the whole control (default "Lock"). */
  label?: string;
  state?: LockState | null;
  /** The lock can also unlatch the door: an Open button. */
  canOpen?: boolean;
  /** Unlock and open ask first: the first tap turns the button into "Tap again to unlock" for a few seconds. */
  confirm?: boolean;
  /** How long the second step waits, in ms (default 4000). */
  confirmTimeout?: number;
  disabled?: boolean;
  labels?: Partial<Omit<LockControlLabels, 'states'>> & { states?: Partial<LockControlLabels['states']> };
  onLock?: () => void;
  onUnlock?: () => void;
  onOpen?: () => void;
}

export interface LockControlHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  /** Applies changed options; omitted ones keep their value. A new state ends a pending second step. */
  update(changes: Partial<LockControlOptions>): void;
  /** Stops the second-step timer. */
  destroy(): void;
}

/** Every visible and spoken word, for translation. */
export interface LockControlLabels {
  lock: string;
  unlock: string;
  /** The unlatch button. */
  open: string;
  /** The unlock button's second step when `confirm` is on. */
  confirmUnlock: string;
  /** The open button's second step when `confirm` is on. */
  confirmOpen: string;
  /** The state line, by state (`unknown` when the state is null). */
  states: Record<LockState | 'unknown', string>;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createLockControl, type LockState } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

// Shows the busy state until the lock reports back.
const move = (busy: LockState, done: LockState) => {
  lock.update({ state: busy });
  setTimeout(() => lock.update({ state: done }), 1000);
};

const lock = createLockControl({
  label: 'Front door',
  state: 'locked',
  // Unlocking asks for a second tap.
  confirm: true,
  onLock: () => move('locking', 'locked'),
  onUnlock: () => move('unlocking', 'unlocked'),
});

document.body.append(lock.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { LockControl } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';
import type { LockState } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

export function LockControlExample() {
  const [state, setState] = useState<LockState>('locked');
  // Shows the busy state until the lock reports back.
  const move = (busy: LockState, done: LockState) => {
    setState(busy);
    setTimeout(() => setState(done), 1000);
  };
  return (
    <LockControl
      label="Front door"
      state={state}
      confirm
      onLock={() => move('locking', 'locked')}
      onUnlock={() => move('unlocking', 'unlocked')}
    />
  );
}
```
